title: Chicken Pot Pie
subtitle: The ultimate comfort food that fills your kitchen with the most amazing aromas and your heart with pure satisfaction

story.title: Pure Comfort in Every Bite
paragraphs: This isn't just any chicken pot pie - this is the kind that makes your whole house smell like home and brings everyone running to the dinner table. With a flaky, buttery crust and a rich, creamy filling packed with tender chicken and vegetables, it's comfort food at its absolute finest.

I've perfected this recipe over decades, and it never fails to be a crowd favorite. The secret is that incredibly flaky crust and a filling that's perfectly seasoned and satisfying. It's the kind of meal that creates memories and fills hearts as much as stomachs. 🥧💕

ingredientGroups.title: For the Flaky Crust
items: ¾ cup butter, cut into pieces

steps.title: Make the Flaky Crust
steps.body: Mix flour and salt in a bowl. Add shortening and work the butter into the flour using a dough cutter until mixture resembles tiny pebbles. Add egg, 4-5 tablespoons cold water, and white vinegar. Stir until just combined. Divide dough in half and chill at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the Chicken
steps.body: Boil chicken breasts in salted water until tender, about 15-20 minutes. Remove and let cool, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Save 1¾ cups of the cooking broth for the filling.

steps.title: Prep for Assembly
steps.body: Preheat oven to 425°F. Roll out one dough half and place in an ungreased 9-inch pie pan. Press against bottom and sides.

steps.title: Make the Filling
steps.body: In a large saucepan, cook carrots, celery, and onion in margarine until tender, about 5-8 minutes. Stir in flour, salt, pepper, celery seed, and thyme until well mixed.

steps.title: Create the Sauce
steps.body: Gradually stir in chicken broth and milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens. Remove from heat and stir in cooked chicken pieces.

steps.title: Assemble the Pie
steps.body: Pour hot chicken mixture into pastry-lined pie pan. Roll out remaining dough and place over filling. Seal edges and cut several slits in top crust to allow steam to escape.

steps.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
steps.body: Bake for 30-40 minutes or until crust is golden brown. If crust browns too quickly, cover edges with foil. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

tips.title: Hot Filling Secret
tips.body: Pour the hot filling into the pie shell immediately - this helps the bottom crust cook properly and prevents sogginess.

tips.title: Veggie Perfection
tips.body: Cook the vegetables until just tender - they'll continue cooking in the oven and you don't want them mushy!

tips.title: Save That Broth
tips.body: Using the chicken cooking broth in the filling adds incredible depth of flavor - don't skip this step!

tips.title: Steam Vents
tips.body: Don't forget steam vents - those slits in the top crust are crucial to prevent the filling from boiling over and the crust from getting soggy.

footer.heading: Ultimate Comfort Food!
footer.text: This pot pie is pure love on a plate - perfect for family dinners, potlucks, or anytime you need a warm hug in food form! 🥧💕
